decisions.reason: The clothing join is a complete current base; no smaller productive English pieces are proposed.
The shoe component is a whole base. The current reviewed registry supplies no incompatible sole donor.
Whole shoe-component base avoids inventing a suffix or conflating the displayed noun with another pronunciation.
Sleeve is a whole clothing-part base, not a spelling-chunk composition.
Collar is taught as the complete clothing noun; final letters do not justify a productive suffix here.
Waist plus band transparently names the garment strip; the strip-valued Growth band donor is compatible.
The inner-covering verb line supports result-noun ing; the authored final-e removal yields lining. Its identity excludes a drawn line.
Care plus label preserves the lexical space and upkeep meaning, sharing the existing label object and care-maintenance families.
Whole-base teaching avoids presenting historically recoverable letters as a transparent productive modern split.
Whole-term exposure is a valid declared depth; the rationale does not deny the allergy/gen family or claim medical review.
The serving amount is a whole base; port plus ion would be a misleading lesson for this meaning.
Net after deductions plus weight is transparent and preserves the word boundary; the net identity excludes networking and mesh.
Standard-quantity unit plus price expresses the selected noun and avoids an unrelated organizational unit.
Item-group pack plus quantity size matches the lexical sense; the space remains part of the completed term.
Many-valued multi plus the same item-group pack is a transparent formation with a supported combining-form identity.
Re again plus fill supports the refill family; noun conversion is explicit and no invented noun suffix is added.
Complete product-example base is appropriate; its identity excludes independently defined research or specimen senses.
Modern demonstrate plus ion yields demonstration by authored final-e removal, then joins product-example model with a space. The partial is legal without awarding whole-term mastery.
The extra product is a whole lexical base; access plus ory would misteach the selected meaning.
Replacement-valued spare plus component part transparently forms the term while preserving its space and excluding other part senses.
